Name: Platonic's Kynseed Plants
Author: Macskasajt
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Requires SMAPI and Json Assets[/b]

At the moment, this mod contains the "Gassy Apple", the "Sugar Plum", the totally useful "Rotten Apple" tree, and the "Nightberry". At the moment I feel like the mod is complete, but if you have any recommendations tell me at the "Posts" section.





[center][size=5]List of fruits:[/size][/center]

- Gassy Apple
- Sugar Plum
- Rotten Apple
- Nightberry
- And various foraging ones.




[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]If you have any suggestions how to make the mod better, please write it down at the "Posts" section.[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font][list]
